import json, sys, os
from pathlib import Path

project_dir = sys.argv[1]

# Verify system-spec-harness plugin requirements
plugin_root = Path(project_dir) / "plugins" / "system-spec-harness"
manifest = plugin_root / ".claude-plugin" / "plugin.json"

if not manifest.exists():
    print(json.dumps({"status": "FAIL", "reason": "plugin manifest not found"}))
    sys.exit(1)

with open(manifest) as f:
    manifest_data = json.load(f)

required_skills = [
    "run-system-spec-elicit",
    "run-system-spec-doc-fetch", 
    "run-system-spec-compile",
    "assign-system-spec-completeness-evaluator"
]

package_contract = plugin_root / "references" / "package-contract.json"
if not package_contract.exists():
    print(json.dumps({"status": "FAIL", "reason": "package-contract.json not found"}))
    sys.exit(1)

with open(package_contract) as f:
    contract = json.load(f)

entry_points = contract.get("entry_points", {}).get("skills", [])
entry_point_names = [s.get("name") if isinstance(s, dict) else s for s in entry_points]

missing = [s for s in required_skills if s not in entry_point_names]
if missing:
    print(json.dumps({"status": "FAIL", "reason": f"Missing entry points: {missing}"}))
    sys.exit(1)

print(json.dumps({
    "status": "PASS",
    "plugin_root": str(plugin_root),
    "manifest_name": manifest_data.get("name"),
    "version": manifest_data.get("version"),
    "required_skills": required_skills,
    "found_skills": entry_point_names
}))
PYTHON
